text:
alex: quick q — onboarding config schema: our spec currently treats tokenizer_overrides as non-nullable. A couple teams shoved "tokenizer_overrides": null when tokenizer metadata was missing. Validator rejects null. Should null == omitted or should we disallow null?

marta: my vote: null should mean 'use artifact default' and be allowed. omitting the field == same thing. But that requires validator + runtime agreement.

ryan: fwiw we originally disallowed null because older runtime did attribute access assuming dict and would crash. we merged a runtime guard last month (2366000000) but schema never updated.

sunita: short-term workaround: teams can use omission. but some infra scripts produce explicit nulls (json.dumps({'tokenizer_overrides': None})) so they'll hit the lint.

alex: can we change the schema to anyOf: object | null, and make validator coerce null -> missing? I want explicit {} to mean "user provided empty overrides" (which should be validated later), and null to mean "use artifact defaults".

marta: agree. proposal: tokenizer_overrides: { "anyOf": [ {"type": "object"}, {"type": "null"} ], "description": "null => use artifact tokenizer; omit => same as null; empty object => explicit overrides (validated)" }

ryan: also a separate but related finding: weight_uri canonicalization is flaky. validator currently enforces s3:// pattern; our new model has gs://redwood-weights/... and CI linter failed. we should accept s3|gs|https.

alex: good catch. I hit that earlier — some onboarding scripts canonicalize gs:// -> https://storage.googleapis.com/ which then trips other checks. we need consistent canonicalization rules across ingest + validator.

deploy-bot: lint-validator v2.4.0 deployed to staging. To run locally: `tools/config-lint --schema v2.4.0 path/to/model/config.json` :white_check_mark:

marta: I'll open a small PR with three things: (1) schema anyOf null|object for tokenizer_overrides, (2) weight_uri pattern to accept gs|s3|https, (3) a test matrix covering omitted/null/{}/bad-fields. I'll also add a short onboarding note: prefer omission for default.

ryan: can someone add a quick runtime smoke after schema bump? command I use: ```./run_local_runtime --config model/config.json --weights gs://redwood-weights/my-model/ --mode smoke``` we should confirm null->fallback works and {} gets validated as explicit.

alex: I'll run that in ~15m and post results. if it fails we can revert validator change or add guard. ping me if you need me to run extra cases. :thumbsup:

marta: thanks — i'll tag the PR with eng-ml + eng-runtime reviewers and add a short blurb in the onboarding checklist.

sunita: tiny nit: update onboarding doc to mention CI linter version requirement (tools/config-lint >= v2.4.0) or people will get confusing failures.

alex: noted. will add to checklist.

ryan: thanks all. small but important — good to make semantics explicit rather than implicit. :eyes:
